game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the forest ranger must hold off mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Squad Marcher: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: In Canopy Walkway, repeat each round: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job. Then check squad_ready and advance.
player_objective: Protect the spirit shrine from mischievous sprites in Canopy Walkway: keep squad_ready above zero until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Squad Marcher
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 4, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
